hero.headline: Soft *blue* everyday.
hero.subtext: Considered essentials in calm tones — cut slow, stitched to last, curated by Lisa Marak.

specs.title: Fabric
specs.text: 12oz brushed cotton twill, garment-washed for a broken-in hand from day one.

specs.title: Fit
specs.text: Relaxed through the body, dropped shoulder, cropped just above the hip.

specs.title: Stitching
specs.text: Triple-needle seams and bar-tacked stress points. Built for years, not seasons.

specs.title: Details
specs.text: Brass two-way zip, corduroy collar, twin chest pockets, ribbed cuffs.

about.heading: Owned & curated by *Lisa Marak*.
paragraphs: Blubstore started with a simple idea: a wardrobe should feel like a calm morning. Lisa Marak hand-picks every piece for fabric, fit and finish — fewer things, chosen well, in soft colours that work together.
Every order is personally confirmed by Lisa by email or phone before it ships.
